description: This file defines internal data structures related to persistent stream consumers in Orleans, including an enum for consumer state and a class for consumer data management, with methods for safe disposal of cursors.

classes.name: StreamConsumerData
classes.description: Represents data related to a stream consumer, including subscription info, stream ID, consumer extension, state, cursor, last token, and filter data, with a method for safe disposal of the cursor.

methods.name: StreamConsumerData
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream consumer data with subscription ID, stream ID, consumer extension, and filter data.

methods.name: SafeDisposeCursor
methods.description: Safely disposes of the cursor associated with the consumer data, catching and logging exceptions.
